reading.title: The four-day week
reading.text: The idea of a four-day working week is gaining traction. Companies that have tried it say it helps them attract talented staff, and workers report fewer distractions because meetings are shorter. In a recent British trial, most firms chose to keep the new schedule after the six-month contract ended. Critics argue that you cannot simply subtract a day without losing output, and one newspaper had to retract a claim that productivity had doubled. Still, researchers extracted useful data: sick days fell by two thirds, and almost no employee wanted to return to five days.
